name: brick-mortar-skills
description: Brick & Mortar's agent skills: small-business research, Reddit research, platform APIs, trading, personas, creative tools.

plugins.name: bm-creative
plugins.description: Making things look right: AI art, riffs on a reference, study sheets, brand directions, deterministic video, wallpapers, photo touch-up, UI directions and mobile audits.

plugins.name: bm-personas
plugins.description: Reasoning lenses as personas: a tech economist, an industrial-design critic, a product visionary, a sales closer, and synthetic customers to test an idea on.

plugins.name: bm-platforms
plugins.description: Working notes for the APIs and dashboards a small software business runs on: Clover, Square, Jobber, Stripe, Vercel, PostHog, Search Console, Google Calendar, Zoho, Apple apps, Chrome, Mixam, remote MCP servers.

plugins.name: bm-small-business
plugins.description: Small-business research on top of the Small Business Intelligence MCP server: teardowns, competitor maps, review and pricing reads, local visibility, buyer diligence, public records.

plugins.name: bm-toolkit
plugins.description: General method skills: turning sessions into skills, falsifying a dataset's laws, reframing, divergent ideas, distribution, research-paper essays and more.

plugins.name: bm-trading
plugins.description: A brokerage-account harness: pull positions, check stops, review the book, realized P&L, entry timing, intrinsic value, sector and catalyst screens.
